question: On the eight development fixtures, do fully trained recurrent and symbolic learners solve the delayed task trivially, fail to learn the source, or leave measurable headroom for direct-weight programming?
worlds: FIXTURE-0..7 only; hard reject all original PUBLIC/RESERVED IDs
source: 24 common four-step passive episodes + eight four-step investigative episodes (128 observations total) per fixture; identical input/action episodes for all strong controls
heldout: 24 distinct heldout initial six-bit states, each with two three-action branches; action sequences and predictions fixed before target outcome read

controls.symbolic: Independent full version-space model from controls.py; exact source-fit and heldout terminal bit accuracy
controls.rnn: GradientTanhRNN with seeds 11,17,23, 1800 epochs each; source-only model selection
controls.gru: GradientGRU16 with seeds 11,17,23, 1800 epochs each; source-only model selection
controls.memoryless: GradientMemoryless seeds 11,17,23, 1800 epochs each; source-only model selection
controls.oracle: ONLY task evaluator invoked after every model's predictions are frozen per method; no hidden latches or true causal-program labels in learners.

selection: For each trained family, choose seed with smallest source training BCE, then greatest teacher-forced source-bit fit, then smallest seed. Never inspect heldout labels to choose winners.
outcome_metrics: CPU training time per model and whole pilot

classification.DEV_CEILING: Both symbolic and at least one fully-trained recurrent best-of-3 achieve >95% terminal accuracy, or any strongest source-qualified control achieves >95%; this is evidence source task too easy for unique direct-write advantage, not independent science.
classification.DEV_HEADROOM: At least one strong control reaches >=95% source fit AND strongest qualified control terminal accuracy between 65% and 95% inclusive AND recurrent vs memoryless terminal gain >=8 percentage points; test-headroom engineering signal only, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification.DEV_LEARNING_BLOCKED: Best neural source fit <95%; must report strong-control training inadequacy, not a model superiority claim.
classification.DEV_NEGATIVE: No history benefit or identifiability despite source fit; preserve and do not use original PUBLIC merely to retune.
classification.INVALID: Any program/hidden readout to source policy or learner, budgets changed, heldout-driven selection, original source instantiation, contamination, numerical divergence, unequal history/action budgets, or original identities.

execution: Explicitly gated once-only development workflow, CPU only on public hosted runner with NumPy 2.1.3 and Python 3.12, no paid APIs. Require exact Git source SHA and unchanged original world custody. No official loop/controller/queue use.
after: Do not alter any training hyperparameter or task law in response to this pilot's results. If ceiling or blocked, diagnose and open fresh separately preregistered successor rather than consuming original first-use.
